2493-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2493-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3518-3734-4812-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {3}{U/P}, causing it to enter as an artifact copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1477-3682-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-3682-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Mox Amber, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

676-1170-8210.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1170-8210.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Konstrari Improviser. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

5078-6766-6965-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3734-4247-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=2 that is colorless and enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it

2034-5660-6012--36.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with MV<=2 if it doesn't have {X} in its mana cost, or enough to cast it with X=1 otherwise.
2034-5660-6012--36.description:
Cast the creature from your hand by paying {2} or less, causing the creature to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
If the creature can be cast for {C} or less, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may cast that creature for an arbitrarily large amount of mana if it has {X} in its mana cost.

330-7186-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
You control your commander.
Collective Inferno has one of your commander's creature types chosen.
330-7186-7839.description:
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Collective Inferno.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2757-3000-5285.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1993-3756-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
1993-3756-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

1116-2292-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1116-2292-2946-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3457-5457-7791.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Selvala.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Selvala.
Repeat.

1409-2933-5798-7730.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-5798-7730.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3330-3490-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-3490-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4689-4885.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4689-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least two cards in all hands.
5256-6972-7234.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1494-1954-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-1954-4613-7152.description:
Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {3}{W}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-1954-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Change of Heart. Change of Heart is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

1796-2034-4871-5497-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

2511-4200-4681.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-5220-6537-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
When Tarpan enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1170-1482-3200-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1482-3200-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

5256-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
5256-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

215-1912-2246-6726.description:
Cast Ruby either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} due to Bard Class plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Ruby by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {G}, returning Ruby from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-1912-2246-6726.notes: If Bard Class is level 3, you will also exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn.

915-5527-5856.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Clues.
You control a Food.
915-5527-5856.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

2136-5090-6252.notablePrerequisites:
Boommobile is a creature.
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Singing Bell Strike attached to Orthion.
2136-5090-6252.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {16}{R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
2136-5090-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Orthion's ability or activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1486-4452-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-4452-4644.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

64-2104-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Warden of the Eye each turn.
64-2104-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Warden of the Eye by paying its mana cost.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Warden of the Eye from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

539-3197-6081.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

1061-2506-3395.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} each turn, plus an additional {3} or {U} available each turn
1061-2506-3395.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing and/or control at least eight permanents.
"Human", "Pirate", or "Wizard" chosen with Molten Echoes.
1061-2506-3395.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing and control ten or more permanents, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {3} or {U} and tapping it, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

643-1821-3764-4659.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
When the Pincher enters the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Maskwood Nexus, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Incubator, adding {C}{C}.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1409-2696-2781.notablePrerequisites:
You control an artifact, a creature, and/or a land that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Felidar Guardian.
1409-2696-2781.description:
Activate a mana-producing artifact, creature, and/or land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping the mana-producing permanents and causing you to gain two life.
Activate Felidar Guardian by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Teferi.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Felidar Guardian.
Repeat.

579-2107-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Sunastian Falconer.
Sunastian Falconer does not have summoning sickness.
579-2107-2816.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sunastian Falconer by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

914-3198-4953.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3198-4953.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U/R}{U/R}{U}{R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, mutating it on top of Dockside Extortionist.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Chain of Vapor from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chain of Vapor by paying {U}, returning Lore Drakkis and Dockside Extortionist to your hand and choosing not to copy Chain of Vapor.
Repeat.
